verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no native auto-reply, missed-call text-back, after-hours SMS reply or scheduled-text feature in Aircall. The Messages API tutorial (docs-10) is a developer building block for building SMS automation, not the capability itself. The after-hours AI Agents claim (docs-24) covers calls, not texts.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can send auto-replies and scheduled texts, like missed-call text-back and after-hours replies
